name: Xavier
source:
Xavier is [url=https://vndb.org/c167538]Kiara[/url]'s former boyfriend and current classmate. The two were seemingly having issues for sometime until it came to explosive head after he slapped Kiara. Thankfully, [url=https://vndb.org/c167447]Byron[/url] was able to intervene and stop him before more harm could occur.
